ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c), IsConverted, ISPICKVAL(ER_BUPicklist__c, "BENELUX"), OR( ISBLANK(Email), NOT(REGEX(Email, "(^$)|^([a-zA-Z0-9#_\\-\\.\\+']+)@((\\[[0-9]{1,3}\\.[0-9]{1,3}\\.[0-9]{1,3}\\.)|(([a-zA-Z0-9\\-]+\\.)+))([a-zA-Z]{2,63}|[0-9]{1,3}|[a-zA-Z]{2,63}[0-9])(\\]?)$")) ), NOT($Profile.Name = "Integration Profile") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill in a valid Email address.
